task_intro: This dataset predicts the quality evaluation of a car based on buying price, maintenance cost, door count, passenger capacity, luggage boot size, and safety level.

cat.buying: buying price category of the car
cat.maint: maintenance cost category of the car

target_intro.unacc: the car is unacceptable for purchase under the current attribute combination
target_intro.acc: the car is acceptable but not considered a strong recommendation
target_intro.good: the car is considered good and meets the buyer's needs well
target_intro.vgood: the car is considered very good and stands out across the evaluated criteria
